Event coordination and production

One plan, one point of contact.

We bring the setting, hospitality and entertainment into one practical plan, then coordinate the people who deliver it.

  • For venues

    A commissioned evening for your audience: concept, schedule, entertainment and suppliers, with a briefing for your team and an on-site lead.

    Inquire as a venue

  • For companies

    A social for your team, clients or partners: an agreed proposal, budget and schedule, coordinated suppliers and an on-site lead.

    Inquire for a company

  • For private hosts

    A birthday, anniversary or private gathering: a plan you approve, supplier coordination and someone to run it on the day.

    Inquire about a private event

What happens next: send a short inquiry; an event concept is enough to begin. A free 15–20 minute fit call finds the right service, then a written proposal confirms the fee and what is included.

Meet Dante David.

I’m Dante David, a Genova-based event organizer originally from the USA and founder of YMG Events. Through Porto Aperto | Genova, I’ve built a thriving international community around music, nightlife, and shared experiences.

My team and I bring years of experience organizing everything from intimate gatherings to music festivals and international travel adventures. We work closely with clients, venues, and partners to create memorable experiences. We handle the details so you can enjoy yourself at the event.
